entries.text: You see a Member of the Children of the Cathedral.
entries.source_text: You see a Member of the Children of the Cathedral.

entries.text: I do not speak with heathen souls such as yourself.
entries.source_text: I do not speak with heathen souls such as yourself.

entries.text: The Master is pleased with your progress, but his need is great and time is limited.
entries.source_text:
The Master is pleased with your progress, but his
 need is great and time is limited.

entries.text: The Master should know that raw material is limited. We cannot create our soldiers without more stock.
entries.source_text:
The Master should know that raw material is limited.
 We cannot create our soldiers without more stock.

entries.text: He is aware of your problems. He is working on it, as we speak.
entries.source_text:
He is aware of your problems. He is working on it,
 as we speak.

entries.text: Tell me of his plans. We will need to coordinate activities, if the Unity is to succeed.
entries.source_text:
Tell me of his plans. We will need to coordinate
 activities, if the Unity is to succeed.

entries.text: The Master has become aware of an undiscovered, and living, Vault. With that much raw material, we can create a great force. According to the prediction software, it will be the numbers we need to succeed.
entries.source_text:
The Master has become aware of an undiscovered, and
 living, Vault. With that much raw material, we can
 create a great force. According to the prediction
 software, it will be the numbers we need to succeed.

entries.text: Excellent. This is most fortuitous. Are the inhabitants contaminated?
entries.source_text:
Excellent. This is most fortuitous. Are the inhabitants
 contaminated?

entries.text: Oh, this is the best part. If their representative is any example, they are clean. Pure-strain.
entries.source_text:
Oh, this is the best part. If their representative is
 any example, they are clean. Pure-strain.

entries.text: Oh, this is most exciting. What Vault is it that we plunder?
entries.source_text:
Oh, this is most exciting. What Vault is it that we
 plunder?

entries.text: Vault-13. And we shall have them soon. Very soon.
entries.source_text: Vault-13. And we shall have them soon. Very soon.

entries.text: You gain 1000 experience points for overhearing the whole conversation about your Vault.
entries.source_text:
